explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows bumetanide injection from multiple manufacturers with resolved status since 2017-12-13; Hikma's registered plant has only VAI inspections and a recent NAI inspection on 2026-05-13

sentences.text: FDA first posted the bumetanide injection shortage on 2017-12-13 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 106 months.

The shortage entries for Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, MSN Laboratories Private Limited, and Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. all show resolved status with an update date of 2026-09-30.
Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. is a registered plant (FEI 2220525) for bumetanide 0.25 mg/mL with operations including manufacture, analysis, and labeling.
FDA inspections of Hikma's plant from 2009 through 2024 have all been classified VAI, with the most recent inspection ending 2024-06-12 and a known date of 2024-12-16.
The plant's last inspection was NAI on 2026-05-13, indicating no action indicated at that time.
P&T has approved interchange to Hikma's bumetanide 0.25 mg/mL (NDC 00641600710) as a same product, alternate manufacturer option approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-07-01.
Corvale East and Corvale General each have approximately 19 days of bumetanide supply on hand at current usage rates.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-97d2ed.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%bumetanide%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%bumetanide%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-74138c.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('05cb961d-ac33-4bcf-b04e-411e496c43c1', '681b5e9d-e2c7-4f29-aaad-e06d4a528c11', 'c38a404d-a919-4a2c-9fbb-d0655dee9516', '525138cd-832a-41d0-84b0-83921b12bd2a') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-20439b.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%bumetanide%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-149587.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%bumetanide%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-174ae0.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%bumetanide%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-09fdea.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3005430968', '2220525') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-395d0c.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3005430968', '2220525') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-69504c.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3005430968', '2220525') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('sandoz', 'zydus lifesciences', 'hikma', 'sagent')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-f24626.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('sandoz', 'zydus lifesciences', 'hikma', 'sagent', 'zydus') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%bumetanide%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-30dcd8.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00185012801', '00641600710', '25021032104', '68382052506')
